assistant.name: Assistant name
assistant.customPlaceholder: e.g. like an encouraging older sibling who jokes a little

claude-cli.name: Claude Code CLI (recommended)
claude-cli.description: Uses your Claude Pro/Max plan through Claude Code signed in on this computer.

anthropic-api.name: Anthropic API key (fallback)
anthropic-api.description: Uses an API key you create on Claude Console; usage is billed to your own account.

ai.invalidKey: Invalid key format (should start with sk-ant-).
ai.noSecureStorage: This computer has no secure storage, so the API key cannot be saved.
ai.getKey: Create a key on Claude Console

beta.name: Beta
beta.description: Also receive pre-releases to try new features — may contain bugs.

status.unsupported: This build does not support auto-update (dev or local build).

skills.description: Teach {{name}} your own way of working with skills (a folder with SKILL.md, like Claude skills). {{name}} picks a few skills that fit each question instead of using all of them. Skills are text only — the app never runs bundled scripts.
skills.howToCall: Call one by name in chat: "use skill <name>" or "/<name>".

preview.title: Install skill "{{name}}"?
preview.replaces: A skill with this name exists — installing replaces it.
preview.skipped: Skipped (scripts, binary or oversized files — not installed, never run)
preview.textOnly: Read the content before installing: the skill is added to the assistant instructions whenever it is picked.

style.proposed: Suggestions — untick or edit before saving
style.nothing: Nothing new about your style yet.
style.error: Could not learn right now. Try again later.
style.addPlaceholder: Add a note yourself, e.g. Dark slides, large text

errors.no_skill_md: No SKILL.md found in the package.
errors.many_skill_md: The package has several SKILL.md files — install one skill at a time.
errors.bad_frontmatter: SKILL.md needs a frontmatter with name and description.
errors.bad_name: Skill names may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.builtin_name: Same name as a built-in app skill — rename the skill.
errors.bad_zip: The .zip file is broken or unreadable.
errors.unreadable: Could not read the selected folder / file.
errors.install: Install failed. Try picking the package again.

theme.label: Light / dark mode
theme.description: System, light or dark. The sun / moon button in the side bar switches quickly.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.description: Color of buttons, selected items and highlighted borders.

profile.label: Name, avatar, personality, language
profile.description: Used everywhere in the app and in how the assistant replies. Only you see it.

myStyle.label: Your style (my-style)
myStyle.description: Notes on how you like answers, slides, documents and code. Only what you approve is saved.

autoSuggestMemory.label: Suggest memories automatically
autoSuggestMemory.description: When you leave a chat with at least 2 new messages, the assistant suggests what to remember. You still approve before saving.

memory.label: What the assistant remembers
memory.description: View, add, edit or delete memories and your profile.

provider.label: Run the assistant with
provider.description: Everyone uses their own account / key.

apiKey.label: Anthropic API key
apiKey.description: Encrypted by Windows, stored only on this computer, never sent to anyone but Anthropic.

cliCheck.label: Check Claude Code CLI
cliCheck.description: See whether the CLI is installed and signed in.

aiTitles.label: Give chats short titles automatically
aiTitles.description: After the first reply, a cheap model (Haiku) writes a 2–6 word title. Renaming keeps your name.

suggestGroups.label: Suggest a group for new chats
suggestGroups.description: Matches keywords against group names (free), otherwise asks along with the title. Only moves when you accept.

expressive.label: Expressions
expressive.description: Emoji, GIFs, stickers and reactions in replies.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Talk instead of typing (transcription) and hear replies read aloud.
voice.keywords: voice microphone transcription tts stt whisper

computer.label: Computer control (view screen)
computer.description: Experimental, off by default. Read the warning before turning it on.

commands.label: Run git commands (read-only)
commands.description: The assistant may ask to run git status / diff / log / show / branch in the folder you chose. Every run shows the exact command for you to Run or Deny. Off by default.
commands.keywords: command git status diff log show branch run terminal

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.description: Skills, Gmail, Telegram, MCP servers and agent connections — install, turn on / off and configure on the Plugins page.
plugins.keywords: plugin skill install zip gmail telegram email message draft mcp server agent claude desktop code connect connector

version.label: Version
version.description: The app downloads new versions from the team's GitHub Releases. Chats and settings are always kept.

autoCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
autoCheck.description: On launch and every 2 hours. When off, only when you press "Check now".

channel.label: Update channel
channel.description: Stable: official releases only. Beta: pre-releases too, may have bugs.

reportBug.label: Report a bug
reportBug.description: A draft is written for you with the version and recent logs (personal info masked).

schedules.label: Scheduled tasks
schedules.description: The assistant runs prompts on a schedule while the app is open (read-only). Off by default; turning it on shows a warning first.

scheduleTray.label: Hide to the tray when closing
scheduleTray.description: Clicking X hides the app to the tray (bottom-right of the taskbar) so schedules keep running. Only while scheduled tasks are on.

grantFolders.label: Folders per conversation
grantFolders.description: Conversations where the assistant can read (or read + edit) a folder. Revoke = remove the folder from that conversation, cancel every pending card and stop the command / reply running there.
grantFolders.keywords: revoke folder access read edit code conversation remove

grantGit.label: git commands (read-only)
grantGit.description: One switch for every conversation with a folder — change it under Capabilities. Each run still needs your approval.

grantSchedules.label: Schedule permissions
grantSchedules.description: Permissions fixed when each schedule was created. Revoking one saves right away, stops a run that is using it and closes pending deferred cards that rely on it.
grantSchedules.keywords: schedule permission revoke folder gmail telegram draft

grantConnections.label: Gmail, Telegram, agents, MCP
grantConnections.description: Status only — turn on / off, remove and "always allow" are managed on the Plugins page.
grantConnections.keywords: gmail telegram agent mcp connection plugin always allow status

actionLog.label: Activity log
actionLog.description: Every time the assistant asks to run a command, edit a file, call an MCP tool or create a draft, it is recorded with the decision. Stored on this computer only, kept for 90 days, file / command / tool names only — never contents.
actionLog.keywords: log history activity audit permission privacy file edit command git mcp draft gmail telegram approve reject

commands.gitNotFound: git was not found on this computer (install Git for Windows).
commands.gitTooOld: git {{version}} is too old — please update Git (needs the --attr-source option).

actionLog.empty: No activity yet. Each time the assistant asks to edit a file, run a command, call an MCP tool or create a draft, it shows up here.
